(Shri Subodh Choudhary Advocate For Applicant)

 Order

This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No. 5/2022 registered at Police Station Baghna, District Neemuch (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 376, 376(D), 376(2)(I)(J), 450/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
Counsel for applicant seeks permission to withdraw this M.Cr.C.
He contended that since applicant has suffered jail incarceration for more than two and half years, therefore, trial court be directed to conclude the trial expeditiously.
Looking to the jail incarceration period of applicant, the trial court is directed to make all endeavour to conclude the trial as early as possible.
